name: Grab Plate Then Pose v2
description: Grip a wellplate with the right arm at hold_plate and hold it in place, then run the left arm through the captured left_arm_pose_sequence_2 trajectory (22 waypoints), then release the plate and clear the right arm out of the way.
author: zeon

nodes.label: Hold Plate Down
nodes.description: Grip the plate at its 'hold_plate' anchor with the right arm and hold it in place — no lift, no retract.

nodes.label: Left Arm Pose Sequence 2
nodes.description: Run the left arm through the captured 22-waypoint trajectory (v2). Never touches the right arm, so the plate hold is undisturbed.

nodes.label: Release Plate (Final)
nodes.description: Release the plate and retreat the right arm to its staging pose, clearing it out of the way. Plate is not relocated.
